focus.title: 美国拟对东南亚光伏产品加征反倾销税，中国转口企业面临合规风险
focus.summary: 美国商务部初步裁定，对从越南、泰国、马来西亚和柬埔寨进口的太阳能电池板征收反倾销税，税率最高达271.2%。此举旨在堵住中国光伏企业通过东南亚转口规避关税的漏洞。相关中国企业需重新评估供应链布局，并准备应对美国海关的溯源调查。
focus.title_en: U.S. Proposes Anti-Dumping Duties on Southeast Asian Solar Imports, Targeting Chinese Transshipment
focus.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Commerce preliminarily ruled to impose anti-dumping duties on solar panels imported from Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, and Cambodia, with rates up to 271.2%. The move aims to close loopholes used by Chinese solar firms to circumvent tariffs via Southeast Asian transshipment. Affected Chinese enterprises should reassess supply chains and prepare for U.S. Customs traceability investigations.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁定：跨境合资企业中方股东可依“重大不利变更”条款退出
case.summary: 在SIAC仲裁案中，一家中马合资企业的中方股东以马来西亚政府突然调整外资持股比例限制为由，援引合资协议中的“重大不利变更”（MAC）条款成功退出。仲裁庭认定政策变化构成MAC，支持中方撤回全部投资并免除违约责任。该案提示中国企业在跨境合资中应明确MAC条款的触发条件与救济措施。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC） · 2026年6月裁决
case.title_en: SIAC Rules Chinese Shareholder May Exit Cross-Border JV Under 'Material Adverse Change' Clause
case.summary_en: In a SIAC arbitration, a Chinese shareholder in a China-Malaysia joint venture successfully invoked the 'Material Adverse Change' (MAC) clause after Malaysia unexpectedly tightened foreign equity caps. The tribunal held that the policy shift constituted a MAC, allowing the Chinese party to withdraw all investment without liability. The case underscores the need for clear MAC triggers and remedies in cross-border JV agreements.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) · June 2026 Award

policy.title: 深圳前海发布跨境数据流动“白名单”管理办法，便利企业合规传输
policy.summary: 深圳市前海管理局正式印发《前海深港现代服务业合作区跨境数据流动“白名单”管理办法（试行）》，明确将金融、物流、科技等领域的特定数据列入白名单，企业向香港传输此类数据无需再逐笔申报安全评估。该办法自2026年7月1日起施行，有效期三年，旨在促进大湾区数据要素高效流动。
policy.source: 来源：深圳市前海管理局 · 2026.06.15
policy.title_en: Qianhai Issues 'Whitelist' Rules for Cross-Border Data Flow, Easing Compliance for Enterprises
policy.summary_en: The Shenzhen Qianhai Authority released the 'Management Measures for Cross-Border Data Flow Whitelist (Trial),' designating specific data categories in finance, logistics, and technology as whitelisted. Enterprises transferring such data to Hong Kong will no longer need to apply for security assessments on a case-by-case basis. Effective July 1, 2026, for three years, the measure aims to boost data mobility within the Greater Bay Area.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期应对策略
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟CBAM过渡期至2025年底，中国出口企业需在2026年1月前完成首次年度申报。建议企业立即开展产品碳足迹核算，建立内部数据采集体系，并选择符合EU-ETS认可的第三方核查机构。同时关注CBAM覆盖范围可能扩展至钢铁下游制品及有机化学品，提前布局减排技术。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Practical Steps for CBAM Transition Period Compliance
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The CBAM transitional period ends in 2025; Chinese exporters must submit their first annual report by January 2026. Companies should immediately start product carbon footprint calculations, set up internal data collection systems, and select third-party verifiers accredited under the EU-ETS. Also monitor potential CBAM expansion to downstream steel products and organic chemicals, and invest early in emission reduction technologies.
